settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configuration for your account, credentials and workspace secrets.
settings.users_description: Human accounts with access to Aethra and the RBAC roles that define their permissions.
settings.api_keys_description: Bearer tokens to integrate external tools and agents with the Aethra API.
settings.integrations_description: Centralized credentials (Cloudflare, GitHub PAT, SMTP, registries) that other modules resolve by name.
settings.domains_description: FQDN that Aethra uses to build hostnames. Only one active at a time, with a confirmed wildcard DNS flag.
settings.environments_description: Catalog of valid environments (production, staging, preview...). Other modules validate slugs against this list.
settings.notifications_description: Channels (Slack/Discord/Telegram/Email/Webhook) that receive alerts from monitors, builds and certificates.
settings.dpkey_description: Master key that encrypts tokens at rest. Controlled rotation.
